timeline.tweet: I thought moving would be scary. But honestly? It’s just exhausting.

We will probably need some help for the move to platteville. But the move down to River Falls is taking place at such awkward time during the week that I would feel really back asking anyone to help. I appreciate the offer though!

First day of moving: Sure, we can probably get all of this packed by the end of the month. Two weeks later: You know what would solve our problems? If we just smashed everything with a hammer and moved it in a dump truck.
Well, the hardest leg of moving is over and I’m tired and cranky but it’s done. One more trip up to settle some detail stuff and then that’s that.

We are moving, waiting a few months and then moving again. And the local internet provider only has year contracts so we are kinda boned. But only for a little bit. But that's one of the many joys of rural living I suppose.

I DID still get married to one of my best friends. And while my grandmothers couldn't be there in person, they got to see the last of each of there grandchild get married. And I DID still graduate college. Something I have struggled with for nearly a decade.
